title: Sample coffee leaves for demo mode
note: Real photos from public sources (Costa Rica, Brazil, Colombia, Guatemala, Hawaii and others). Not from Kenya and not from Noor's farm. Labels are source hints, not verified by an agronomist. Use local_path first; image_url is the public fallback.

items.author: Emily Franzen
items.visual_note: One leaf on an open palm, underside. Many orange powdery pustules and a few brown dead patches. Daylight, sharp.
items.label_status: hint, not verified by an agronomist
items.attribution: Photo: Emily Franzen, iNaturalist, CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Resized to 640 px.
